scenario.name: pigmentampas
scenario.description: S6 (NPDEV_MEGA_ROADMAP.md): greenfield pigment store -- minimal end-to-end proof. Explicit packs[] composes identity + workspace + tracing (WmsOffice's proven pattern -- internal.tables composes AFTER semantic validation, so a user concept referencing a pack concept, like Credential -> identity::User, cannot validate under that mechanism); auth.mode=jwt gives Google signup/link/login plus username/password via the Credential concept; every screen is declaratively generated (zero hand-authored HTML).

notes: S6 Pigmentampas: jwt-mode greenfield proof app on port 8084.
